get.description:
Fetch receipt for a booking item

Request Parameters

Attribute Type Description
bookingId String Id corresponding to the trips summary for which you want to fetch each booking item receipts
itemId String Id corresponding to the booking item for which we want to fetch receipt

Response Parameters in case of successful response

In case of successful response receipt pdf will be send to the partner with 200 OK status

Response Parameters in case of failure response

Attribute Type Description
code String Error code in case of receipt failure
message String Error message in case of failure

Below response with 404 Not Found Error HttpStatus

   
   {
       "error": {
           "code": "EGE-ER-OS-4010",
           "message": "Receipt is unavailable for this booking item."
       }
   }

404.description: Not Found : You are trying to access an invalid or non existent resource.

422.description: Invalid input : invalid or missing required input.

500.description: Internal Server Error : unable to process request
